title: Test query and CRUD commands
description: Write and run integration tests covering all four new subcommands: search, delete, list, and stats. Tests should use a temporary DB to avoid polluting state. Cover happy paths, edge cases (nonexistent IDs, empty DB for stats, --limit 0 for list), and JSON output shapes.
acceptance_criteria: All acceptance criteria from the spec pass against a fresh temporary DB
search returns correct results and respects --limit, --threshold, --source, and --json flags
delete removes from both tables in a transaction; nonexistent ID exits 1
list returns newest-first and filters by source correctly
stats handles both populated and non-existent DBs correctly
No test leaves persistent state in the default DB path
